comment: Pinned agy releases: version -> {url, sha512, platform, team_id}. A pin with a url covers exactly that archive; a pin without one covers every archive of the version. fetch-agy refuses a manifest whose sha512 differs from an applying pin. 1.3.2 darwin_arm64 was verified by downloading the archive (sha512 prefix 02dd409d8d40bdae) and checking the Google team id EQHXZ8M8AV; no digest is invented here. 1.4.6 linux_amd64 was verified on blacky (Fedora 44 x86_64) by fetch-agy's download and sha512 check against the auto-updater manifest.
